label: Supercontinuum (SuperK EXR-20)

tooltip: NKT SuperK EXTREME EXR-20 supercontinuum: 8 W total over the tabulated 400-2400 nm SPD (spectrum=sc_superk, digitized +-20-30% from the Jan 2011 datasheet; 1064 nm residual pump spike clipped), ~5 ps seed pulses at 80 MHz, single-mode, unpolarized (M2<1.1). lambdac is the power-weighted mean of the table.
